questions.question:
This question is based on the words given below.

 (Left) DIE CUP BOX ASK (Right)

 In each of the words, each vowel is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding in the English alphabetical order. In how many letter clusters thus formed, will no vowel appear?
questions.solution:
Given: DIE CUP BOX ASK

According to the question:

In each of the words, each vowel is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding in the English alphabetical order.

Now, changing each letter in the words:

DIE: D → C, I → J, E → F

CUP: C → B, U → V, P → O

BOX: B → A, O → P, X → W

ASK: A → B, S → R, K → J

Thus, the new clusters formed are:

DIE → CJF

CUP → BVO

BOX → APW

ASK → BRJ

In these clusters, the ones without any vowel (A, E, I, O, U) are:

CJF, BVO, APW, BRJ

Thus, 2 cluster of letter without any vowel CJF, BRJ

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 956 521 251 156 335 (Right)

(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
questions.solution:
Given: (Left) 956 521 251 156 335 (Right)

The second digit of the highest number is: 5 (956)

And, 

The first digit of the lowest number is: 1 (156)

So, the addition of the second digit of the highest number and the first digit of the lowest number is:

→ 5 + 1 = 6.

The correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
This question is based on the words given below.

 (Left) ACT BUS CAR DAD (Right)

 In each of the words, each vowel is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding in the English alphabetical order. In how many letter clusters thus formed, will no vowel appear?
questions.solution:
Given: ACT BUS CAR DAD

According to the question:

In each of the words, each vowel is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding in the English alphabetical order.

Now, changing each letter in the words:

ACT: A → B, C → B, T → S

BUS: B → A, U → V, S → R

CAR: C → B, A → B, R → Q

DAD: D → C, A → B, D → C

Thus, the new clusters formed are:

ACT → BBS

BUS → AVR

CAR → BBQ

DAD → CBC

In these clusters, the ones without any vowel (A, E, I, O, U) are:

BBS, BBQ, CBC

Hence, the number of letter clusters where no vowel appears is: 3

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 3".
